Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum:

- Auth options: API key for early tests, OAuth 2.0 with short-lived tokens for Prod, and mention of customer KMS for key storage.
- Routing: region pinning to us-west for latency, fallback to hosted smaller model for reliability.
- Embeddings/rerank: sample pipeline for semantic search + candidate reranking using an embeddings index.

Requested deliverables / proposed next steps:
1) I’ll drop the devkit sample + infra diagram (attached) and a short checklist you can hand to infra.
2) Marissa will propose an on-call window for an architecture deep-dive focused on service-to-service auth and routing.
3) You to confirm which environment you want first (staging vs. on-prem sandbox) and whether PlatformOps wants the openid scope checklist.

Immediate asks for your team: please reply with the preferred environment and any regulatory constraints for keys/data residency.

Attachments: sdk-samplekit-v2.zip (sample apps), infra-diagram.png, openid-scopes-checklist.pdf

A) a 1-page checklist (infra steps for staging)

Marissa — can you pick a 60–90m slot for an architecture deep-dive with PlatformOps and Elena? Prefer tomorrow morning PST if possible.
